So after parsing the `##fileformat` line, `p += len` moves `p` past the `\n` to the `#CHROM` line. Good.

Then `bcf_hdr_parse_line` for the `#CHROM` line returns NULL with `*len = 0`. So `p` stays at the `#CHROM` line.

Then `strncmp("#CHROM\tPOS", p, 10)` matches. `done = 1`.
